mechanism: The 2026-08-28 closure of the 'cheapen the decision' lever family rests on two instruments that both measured TRUNCATION -- Thuitanium's R35 output-token cap (8192 saves 0.98% of output, 12288 saves nothing; duckv9's 768-cap scored 0.22 by cutting the tool call) and our own 08-27 context-trim result (4.9x worse per action, 81 calls to finish one action vs 27 for six). Neither measured SUBSTITUTION: replacing raw carried history with a compacted artifact. Truncation deletes information the next call must re-derive; compaction pays once so the re-derivation is unnecessary. Three independent sources landing 08-25..08-28 point at substitution, one quantified: Agno ARC-AGI-Arcade reports Gemini-3.7-Flash 37.33 -> 96.42 RHAE (above the 95.4 human baseline) when seeded with gpt-5.6's per-game manuals, at 3x FEWER tokens; Symbolica Arcgentica uses subagents returning compressed textual summaries to bound context growth; Ivan Martin Valle (Kaggle topic 737230, 08-28) reports token efficiency moved his score, discounted hard at #491/1.33/40 subs. This matters uniquely on our rail because our own 08-28 decomposition puts 99% of the binding 7920s clock in token generation.
summary: Community rail re-scopes its own 08-28 ruling: the 'cheapen the decision' family is closed for TRUNCATION only, not for COMPACTION. Yesterday's brief issued a FORBID on the whole family; today's evidence shows the two instruments behind it both measured truncation, while an external result quantifies compaction at 2.6x RHAE and 3x fewer tokens on a weak model. Separately, the 08-28 night produced ZERO submissions -- ARCDailySubmit last ran 08-26, the Mac rail produced nothing, sub count frozen at 124 -- so one draw was lost to the gap in a host handover that feedback_one_armed_rail only guards on the overlap side.
lesson: A closure is only as wide as the intervention its instruments actually manipulated. Both instruments behind the 08-28 FORBID cut tokens by DELETING context; neither tested REPLACING context with a compacted artifact, yet the ruling was written over the whole family and would have forbidden the one intervention with external evidence of moving score up and cost down together. Name the manipulated variable in the ruling, not the goal it served. The same shape appears in operations: guarding a host handover against double-fire leaves the zero-fire gap unguarded, and a rail that does not fire looks exactly like a healthy idle one -- assert a NEW submission id after the window, never that a task is Enabled.
